from: University of Notre Dame Graduate School <gradapp@nd.edu>
subject: Funding your research: How Notre Dame grad students win $5M+
body:
Where you go matters—our grad students secure $5M+ in funding every year.

                  Dear Koji, Anwar,                

                  Here's a quick reality check for your graduate school search: where you go matters, but who backs your research matters just as much.                

                  At Notre Dame, our graduate students win an average of $5 million per year in competitive external funding. That's not a coincidence; it's by design.                

                  What that means for your career:                

1 of 40
Notre Dame is one of only 40 U.S. universities with an office dedicated exclusively to graduate grant and fellowship coaching.

12 YRS
Recognized as a national top producer of U.S. Fulbright recipients for 12 consecutive years.

$5M+
Secured on average every year by Notre Dame graduate scholars for research and professional development.

                  Applying for grants as a graduate student builds momentum for your research. At Notre Dame, we ensure all of our students have access to 1-on-1 proposal coaching and exclusive winning application archives so you don't have to do it alone.                

                  Let's build your legacy together.                

Apply to Notre Dame <https://graduateschool.nd.edu/admissions/>

                  Warm regards,

Rachel Williams, Ph.D.
                  Director, Graduate Enrollment Management
The Graduate School | University of Notre Dame


                  The Graduate School * 115 Main Building * Notre Dame, IN 46556
